# AGENTS.md

## Project status

Project evolved (2026-09-03) from a **voice-first public app** to a **Personal AI Assistant (Mia)** — a multi-platform, Mia-style personal assistant. Voice/web foundation from v1.0 is retained and becomes the core; the new target is connecting to **Telegram & Discord** as channels around the same core. See `PRD_Real-Time_Voice_AI_Assistant.md` (v2.0) + `ROADMAP.md`.

Phase status: Fase 0–2 DONE (foundation + core assistant + Telegram/Discord channels). Fase 3/4 personal capabilities DONE (tools, scheduling, memory, monitoring, codebase QA, weekly insight, Mac control, Vision, habits/wind-down, email inbox, learn-from-correction). Fase 5 stability/security mostly DONE (auth, audit, rate-limit, config, backup, observability). Remaining gaps: WhatsApp/Email send, Google Maps Places (parked — needs API key), calendar/email/smart-home deeper integrations (optional). Live test loop: implement → gates (`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npx tsx apps/web/verify.ts`, `npm test`) → live-verify → report → commit only after user approval.

## What this is

Personal AI assistant "Mia" — a command center for personal tasks, reachable from multiple channels (web text+voice, Telegram bot, Discord bot, more later) sharing ONE memory, ONE persona, and ONE tool set. Both a real-time voice assistant (from v1.0) AND a multi-platform chat/automation assistant. Inspired by Mia + Siri/ChatGPT Voice.

## Read the PRD & ROADMAP first

- `PRD_Real-Time_Voice_AI_Assistant.md` (v2.0) — source of truth: requirements, architecture (AI Provider + Channel Adapter abstraction), conversation model, state machine, security/test model, MVP scope, user stories, acceptance criteria.
- `ROADMAP.md` — phase-by-phase development guide (Fase 0 foundation → Fase 1 Core → Fase 2 Channels (Telegram/Discord) → Fase 3 Personal capabilities → Fase 4 Advanced → Fase 5 Stability/Security). Update checkboxes as features land.

Architectural principle (new in v2.0): **Channel Adapter abstraction** — each platform (web/telegram/discord) is an adapter that forwards text/voice to the SAME core Conversation Manager; the core never knows the platform. Adding a channel = adding an adapter, no core change.

Discord gotcha (2026-09-03): a first-ever **DM** arrives as a bare packet that discord.js can't map to a full `Message`, so `messageCreate` never fires even though the gateway receives raw `MESSAGE_CREATE` — symptom: **DM doesn't respond while guild chats work**. Fix: client must set `partials:[Partials.Channel, Partials.Message]` and the handler must `await msg.fetch()` when `msg.partial`. Both are present in `apps/web/src/channels/discord.ts.` Keep them when refactoring.

**Batch-selective tool confirmation (2026-09-15):** a turn that proposes several risky tools used to confirm only `needsConfirmation[0]`, mark the rest `Deferred` (`agent.ts`), and force the model to re-propose them one per turn — the cause of the slow one-command-at-a-time Discord/Telegram hunting loop. Now the agent accepts `confirm_calls?: {call,allow}[]` (singular `confirm_call` still supported for the web UI) and executes/declines every entry in one continuation; channels queue ALL pending calls and show one prompt: reply `ya` (all), `ya 1,3` (subset), or `tidak` (none). Shared parse/format lives in `apps/web/src/channels/replyChunk.ts` (`parseConfirmReply`/`pendingConfirmPrompt`; `bold` param = `**` Discord, `*` Telegram) so the two adapters can't drift. An unparsed reply re-prompts (never silently approves/drops). Unselected calls get a `Not selected` tool result (kept `Deferred` semantics → strict gateways never 400 on missing tool results).

## Repo layout

- `apps/web` — Next.js app (UI, hooks, audio, ConversationManager, provider, `/api/*` proxy routes). `src/audio`, `src/ai`, `src/components`, `src/hooks`, `src/app`, `src/lib`, `persona/`.

## Persona & long-term memory

- Persona files in `apps/web/persona` (`IDENTITY.md`, `DREAMS.md`, `SOUL.md`, `USER.md`) are the **single source of truth** for assistant identity/style and stable user facts. They're loaded server-side (`src/lib/persona.ts`, `loadPersonaPrompt`) and folded into the LLM system prompt every turn, so they persist across server restarts.
- **Live updates (Mia-style)**: the LLM may append a hidden `<persona>` tag to the end of a reply (`<persona>user.name=Naufal;soul.tone=formal</persona>`). `GroqStreamingProvider` strips the tag (never spoken) and writes each entry to the matching file (`user.*` → USER.md, `soul.*` → SOUL.md) via `POST /api/persona` (`src/lib/persona.ts` `upsertPersonaFact`).
- So a user introducing themselves ("my name is Naufal") or asking for a style change ("speak formally") is automatically persisted to `USER.md`/`SOUL.md` and remembered after restart.
- No per-user JSON memory store — the persona .md files are the only memory.

**Identity mapping (2026-09-05):** the owner IS `naufalazhar652952` (also known as `naufalazhar65` on Telegram and display name `Zigen` on Discord). `Zigen` is NOT a new/other user — it maps to the owner's data (`apps/web/.data/users/naufalazhar652952/`). When testing/knowing the owner, prefer `user:"naufalazhar652952"` or the channel's own key; do not mistake `Zigen` for a separate account.

- Choose provider via `NEXT_PUBLIC_AI_PROVIDER` (`mock` default | `groq`) for the voice pipeline, and `DEFAULT_AI_PROVIDER` (+ `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEFAULT_AI_PROVIDER`) for the default LLM provider when a request/channel doesn't specify one — code fallback is `groq`, `.env.local` sets `9router`. Set `GROQ_API_KEY` in `apps/web/.env.local` (server-side only!) for real voice. See `apps/web/.env.example`.
- `GroqStreamingProvider` (`src/ai/GroqStreamingProvider.ts`) implements `AIProvider` and drives: Whisper ASR → Qwen streaming SSE → Orpheus TTS per sentence.
- `VoiceActivityDetector` (`src/audio`) does energy-based VAD on the live mic; `AutoTurnManager` (`src/ai`) runs the gated hands-free loop — VAD is active in **LISTENING** (records utterances, 1s anti-feedback cooldown) and in **SPEAKING** in "barge" mode (higher threshold + 260ms hold, relies on mic echoCancellation) to trigger a voice interrupt over AI audio. The manual Interrupt button also does FR-007.
- Room: `GROQ_VOICE` (autumn/diana/hannah/austin/daniel/troy). Orpheus is **English + Arabic (Saudi) only**; Indonesian now uses a **local macOS voice** (`say -v Damayanti` via `ttsLocal.ts`, `TTS_LOCAL_ID=0` to disable) instead of English pronunciation. Partial STT remains Phase 3.
- Groq STT/TTS are request-based (no WebSocket streaming) — transcripts are final-only. This is why the API is proxied through Next routes holding the key.

## Critical architecture decisions (from PRD)

- **AI Provider must be abstracted** via `AIProvider` (`connect`, `sendAudio`, `sendText`, `interrupt`, `disconnect`). UI/audio never couple to a specific provider. Swap by changing the provider instance only.
- **Conversation state machine** is explicit: IDLE → LISTENING → PROCESSING → SPEAKING → (TURN_END → LISTENING | INTERRUPTED → LISTENING). Real state machine, not ad-hoc booleans.
- **ConversationManager** (`apps/web/src/ai/ConversationManager.ts`) is the only place that forwards provider events into the state machine. UI talks to it, not to providers.
- **Audio pipeline** (§14): Microphone → Capture → Noise Suppression → VAD → Streaming → ASR → Conversation Manager → LLM → TTS → Streaming → Speaker. VAD and real audio streaming are Phase 2/3.
- **MVP latency targets** (§16): mic→processing <100ms, user stops→AI starts <500ms, first AI audio <1.5s, interruption detection <200ms.

## Key invariants to preserve

1. AI Provider abstraction — swap providers without changing UI/audio
2. State machine correctness — invalid transitions impossible (`transition` returns null)
3. Interrupt safety — old generation must not interfere with new turn (providers must abort streams on `interrupt()`; see MockProvider `generationId` and GroqStreamingProvider `generationId` + `AbortController`)
4. Latency budget — every new feature must consider its impact on the <1.5s first-audio target
5. Security — API keys server-side only (they live in `/api/*` route handlers), tool calls validated server-side, no client-side privileged calls

## Gotchas

- MockProvider is synchronous; `sendText`/`sendAudio` stream the canned answer via `setInterval`. Do not rely on its timing in tests.
- The mic permission/audio path (`AudioCapture`) requires a browser; it degrades to `denied`/`error` states gracefully.
- `AudioPlayer` decodes WAV chunks queued per sentence; `pump()` is guard-locked (no concurrent playbacks) and fires `onDrained` when the queue empties. `TURN_END` is emitted only after playback drains (UI calls `ConversationManager.finishTurn()`), so long replies never re-open LISTENING while the tail is still spoken.
- vitest runs the state-machine tests (`npm test` = `vitest run`). The two `verify.ts` proofs are kept and still run via tsx.
- Next.js route files may only export valid Route fields — do not export helpers/constants from a `route.ts` (build fails).

## Plugin / tool system (Fase 4, 2026-09-04) — typecheck/lint/build/test green

`apps/web/src/lib/tools.ts` is now a **plugin registry** instead of a flat `TOOLS` array + `executeTool` switch that could drift apart. Core types: `ToolDefinition` (schema, unchanged), `ToolRisk` (`read`/`write`/`delete`/`transaction`/`external`), `ToolContext { userKey, rawUser }`, and the new `ToolPlugin { definition, execute(args, ctx) }`. The registry `toolRegistry` bundles each tool's schema + implementation in ONE object. Public exports are all **derived from the registry** so they can't diverge:
- `TOOLS = toolRegistry.map(p => p.definition)` — what's sent to the model (agent.ts uses `TOOLS`, and `TOOLS.find(t => t.function.name === c.name)` for `requiresConfirmation`).
- `executeTool(call, rawUser)` — parses JSON args, looks up `getTool(call.name)`, dispatches to `plugin.execute(args, { userKey, rawUser })`, returns `Error: ...` on unknown tool. Per-tool error handling lives inside each plugin's `execute` (preserving the old switch's exact per-case try/catch).
- `registerTool(plugin)` — add/replace a tool at runtime (idempotent by name).

**Adding a new tool = adding one `ToolPlugin` object** (definition + execute) to `toolRegistry` — no separate switch, no list to keep in sync, and it's automatically visible to the model (`TOOLS`) and dispatchable (`executeTool`). **276 tools currently registered** (verified 2026-09-15 via `getTOOLS().length`; the full list is derived from `toolRegistry` → `TOOLS`, never hand-kept). Note: module-level helper functions (webSearch, evaluateArithmetic, fileRead, fileWrite, fileEdit, saveNote, listNotes, deleteNote, scheduleReminder, fetchUrl, searchMemory, addAutomation, ...) are declared later in the file and referenced by the plugin closures — fine because they run at call-time. `verify.ts` still exercises `executeTool` for calculate/save_note/list_notes/delete_note/file_read/exec/write_file/edit_file/memory_get/browser/device/calendar (green). Kept server-side only (imports `node:fs`).

**`exec` read-only shell tool (Fase 4, 2026-09-04):** a new tool (`risk: read`, auto-runs, no FR-014 confirm) that runs a safe inspection command and returns output. Strict allowlist in `tools.ts` (`EXEC_ALLOWLIST`): git (only read-only subcommands status/log/diff/branch/ls-files/show/rev-parse/--version), ls, pwd, cat, node (--version/-v), npm (ls/--version). `EXEC_FORBIDDEN_ARG` rejects `;`/`&&`/`|`/`>`/`<`/`..`/`$(`/backtick, and `EXEC_FORBIDDEN_SRC` blocks paths matching `.env`/`.local`/keys/`node_modules`/`.next`/`.data`/`package-lock`. Runs via `execFile` (no shell interpretation) in `resolveInSandbox(cwd)` (defaults to `repoRoot()`) with a 10s timeout and 60KB output cap; `cwd` may be an absolute path inside an allowed workspace (multi-root sandbox). Verified in `verify.ts` (git status/ls/cat/pwd OK; rm -rf, git push, node -e, pipelines, escapes, too-many-args rejected; multi-root cwd OK).

**Multi-workspace sandbox (Fase 4, 2026-09-04):** `apps/web/src/lib/users.ts` now exports `allowedWorkspaces()` (from `ALLOWED_WORKSPACES` env, comma-separated absolute paths), `sandboxRoots()` (`[repoRoot, ...allowedWorkspaces]`), and `resolveInSandbox(path)` (accepts both relative paths like `README.md` and absolute paths inside an allowed root like `/Users/me/PROJECT/other-app/src`). Both `file_read` and `exec` (`cwd`) use `resolveInSandbox` — a request escapes every root → `Error: path escapes every allowed sandbox root`. `file_read`/`exec` also keep their existing `DENY_SEGMENTS`/`DENY_PATTERNS`/`EXEC_FORBIDDEN_*` guards. `.env.example` documents `ALLOWED_WORKSPACES`; `.env.local` sets it to `flowtest-studio`. `verify.ts` exercises the multi-root sandbox with a temp workspace (absolute resolve succeeds, `../` and `~` and outside paths are rejected).

**Cross-channel `send_channel` (Fase 4, 2026-09-04):** tool (risk `read`, so no FR-014 confirmation — it relays immediately) that sends a message to another registered channel (Telegram ↔ Discord). Backing store is `apps/web/src/channels/pushTarget.ts` — now a **label-keyed registry on `globalThis`**, NOT a module singleton. Reason: bots register from `instrumentation-node.ts` while tools dispatch from route/bundle code, and Next compiles these into distinct webpack modules — a module-level singleton gives each a separate `senders` map, so `send_channel` saw an empty registry even though the bots logged "target registered". Storing the map on `globalThis` (one shared Node process) unifies both bundles. Gotcha: the Discord/Telegram sender targets the owner's last-seen channel, which is only recorded once the owner sends a message since server start — so `send_channel` to Discord fails with "no discord owner channel seen" until the owner chats there first (same as reminder push). Imports of pushTarget are intentionally **relative** everywhere (tools.ts/agent/discord/telegram/automationRunner) so tsx probes resolve; the globalThis state is what guarantees cross-bundle correctness.

**Reminder honest delivery audit (2026-09-14):** a due slot is only marked delivered when a listener actually pushed it to a real target — every listener radio-acks synchronously (`ReminderListener` returns `boolean`). Daily acked → reschedule +24h with `lastFiredAt`/`deliveredAt` recorded; `deliveredAt − lastFiredAt` gap >30min surfaces as "kesampaian TELAT … pas device off" (late replay after a boot), so a replayed wake is never claimed on-time. `reminders_list`/`buildReminderList` print `· terkirim`/`· KELEWAT`/`· kesampaian TELAT`; REMINDER HONESTY prompt tells Mia to own a miss + offer a resend. SSE stream now subscribes BEFORE `takeDueReminders` (replay is acked, no double-push). Exactly-once holds per **delivered** slot; a skipped slot is never claimed delivered. User selected 4 features in order: FR-015 persisted conversation history (DONE) -> tool calling + web search (DONE) -> partial transcript (DONE) -> barge-in (DONE).

FR-015 DONE (typecheck/lint/build + both tsx verifies green, graph updated): groundwork `ConversationManager.serialize()` + `restoreHistory(transcripts)` (apps/web/src/ai/ConversationManager.ts) plus localStorage wiring in apps/web/src/hooks/useVoice.ts — hydrate on mount from `voice-ai.history.<user>` (name read from localStorage `voice-ai.user`), `manager.restoreHistory(saved.transcripts)` when any final transcript exists, and persist `manager.serialize()` on every transcript event. Helpers `historyUser`/`loadHistory`/`saveHistory` keep persistence best-effort (guarded try/catch) and key `voice-ai.history.<user>`. Next up: tool calling + web search.

FR-013 tool calling + web search DONE (typecheck/lint/build + verify green, graph updated): agent loop lives server-side in `/api/llm/route.ts` — first completion stays `stream:true` for fast TTFT; if Groq emits `delta.tool_calls` the route executes them in `apps/web/src/lib/tools.ts` (`TOOLS` = `web_search` + `calculate`) via `executeTool`, appends `assistant(tool_calls)` + `tool` messages, and follows up with another streamed completion, up to `MAX_TOOL_ROUNDS` (last round omits `tools` to force a text answer). Client sees only the final text (never tool deltas). `web_search` = DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API then HTML scrape fallback (`parseResults`, no key); `calculate` = safe recursive-descent arithmetic parser (no eval, whitelist charset). No FR-014 confirmation UI yet (tools are read-only; WRITE/DELETE/TRANSACTION need confirmation later). `verify.ts` extended with an offline calculator section. Known residual: DDG HTML POST may require a `vqd` token in some regions (Instant Answer covers many queries); tool-call turn latency adds ~1-3s. Next up: partial transcript.

FR-016 partial transcript DONE (typecheck/lint/build + verify green, graph updated): real-provider path feeds live partials. `AudioCapture.startRecording()` now uses a 250ms `MediaRecorder` timeslice and exposes `recordedChunkCount` + `snapshotRecording()`; `AutoTurnManager` gains an optional `onPartialAudio` callback that every 1200ms snapshots the growing utterance (skipping when no new chunks) and feeds `ConversationManager.sendPartialAudio` → `AIProvider.sendPartialAudio?` → `GroqStreamingProvider.sendPartialAudio` (Whisper on the partial blob, emits `partial_transcript`). `ConversationManager` only accepts partials in LISTENING (drops late partials racing the final) and treats a partial arriving after a final as a new utterance. Transcript UI already rendered partial state. MockProvider already emitted partials (QA path unchanged). Known residual: each utterance costs ~1 partial STT call per 1.2s of speech + 1 final (Groq free-tier Whisper RPM); truncated-WebM snapshots may occasionally transcribe as empty.

FR-007 voice barge-in DONE (typecheck/lint/build + verify green, graph updated): `AutoTurnManager` is now mode-based (`idle`/`listen`/`barge`). `useVoice` calls `autoTurn.armBargeIn()` on **SPEAKING** (and `stop()` on PROCESSING/INTERRUPTED, `start()` on LISTENING). In barge mode the same VAD runs with a higher threshold (0.03) + 260ms startHold + 500ms endSilence and relies on the mic's `echoCancellation`; detected speech fires `onBargeIn` → `ConversationManager.interrupt()` → INTERRUPT → provider abort (`generationId` + `AbortController`) → `interrupted` → RESUME → LISTENING, discarding any partial assistant output (`activeAssistantEntry = null`). `lastSpeechEndAt` is reset on arm so an immediate early barge-in isn't blocked by the 1s anti-feedback cooldown. Known residual: energy-based barge-in is tuned for mic AEC — very loud speakers may occasionally false-trigger; PROCESSING-phase barge-in still uses the manual Interrupt button only. FR-014 tool confirmation DONE (typecheck/lint/build + both verify green): risky tools now pause for explicit user approval. `apps/web/src/lib/tools.ts` `TOOL` defs gained a `risk` field (`read`/`write`/`delete`/`transaction`/`external`; `requiresConfirmation()` true for non-read); added `save_note` (risk `write`) writing to an in-memory array (no disk, demo-safe). The agent loop (`/api/llm/route.ts`) refactored: `runOneCompletion()` buffers each round and only streams the final answer; read-only tools (`web_search`/`calculate`) auto-execute server-side exactly as before (FR-013); if the model requests a **risky** tool on a fresh turn the route does NOT run it and instead returns a single control frame `@@CONFIRM <json>\n` as the whole body. Continuation is a second POST carrying `confirm_call:{call,allow}` (messages already include the assistant `tool_calls`); allow=true appends the executed tool result, allow=false injects "user declined this action; do NOT execute it". `GroqStreamingProvider` recognizes the `@@CONFIRM` prefix (never TTS's it), parses calls, stashes `pendingTools`, emits new provider event `tool_confirmation_required`, and gains `confirmTool(callId,allow)` which re-invokes the continuation. `ConversationManager` forwards `tool_confirmation`, exposes `confirmTool()`, stays in PROCESSING while awaiting. `useVoice` exposes `pendingConfirmation`/`confirmTool`/`denyTool`; `AIChatCard` renders an amber Confirm/Yes-No banner. `ConversationMessage.content` widened to `string|null` for tool_calls assistant messages. Residual: note store is in-memory; if LLM model lacks function-calling the risky path won't trigger.

Also on this session: (1) LLM endpoint is now configurable — `/api/llm/route.ts` uses `LLM_API_BASE`/`LLM_API_KEY`/`LLM_MODEL` (fallback to Groq); TTS stays on Groq `/api/tts`. `.env.local` currently has `LLM_API_BASE=http://localhost:20128/v1` + `LLM_MODEL=<open-code>` (a leftover proxy config — likely invalid; clear these to fall back to Groq unless the local proxy is running). (2) `useVoice` now calls `manager.connect()` on mount so typed chat works without mic; `ConversationManager.connect()` connects providers without entering LISTENING. (3) UI rebuilt as a floating `AIChatCard` (`components/ui/ai-chat.tsx`, 430→520px→full-height `w-[min(520px,94vw)] h-full`): orb moved inside the card header area via `orb` prop, voice/text output-mode segmented toggle (`voiceOutput` in `useVoice` mutes `audio_delta` and ends turns early when Text), user bubbles now white text on `bg-white/30`, assistant on `bg-white/10`. `FloatingParticles.tsx` uses a deterministic `mulberry32` PRNG (fixed hydration mismatch).

FR-009 voice selection DONE (typecheck/lint/build + both verify green): `GroqStreamingProvider` gained `setTtsSettings(voice)` (per-request `voice` in `/api/tts`); `/api/tts` route accepts+validates `voice` against Groq's 6 (autumn/diana/hannah/austin/daniel/troy, fallback `GROQ_VOICE`/hannah); `useVoice` exposes `voice`+`setVoice`; `AIChatCard` renders a pill selector under the orb. FR-010 multilingual PARTIAL (typecheck + live-verified, graph updated): `/api/tts` is now **language-aware**. Per-sentence heuristic detects Arabic script (U+0600–06FF + extensions) → `canopylabs/orpheus-arabic-saudi` with an Arabic voice (`GROQ_VOICE_AR` default `lulwa`; Arabic voices: abdullah/fahad/sultan/lulwa/noura/aisha); everything else (Indonesian, English, …) → `canopylabs/orpheus-v1-english` fallback (default `GROQ_VOICE`/hannah). Indonesian has NO Groq Orpheus model, so it is honestly TTS'ed in English pronunciation (fallback English confirmed by user). Verified live: Indonesian sentence → 200 audio/wav (RIFF PCM mono 24kHz 242KB); Arabic → routes to Arabic model but returns 502 `model_terms_required` until the user accepts the Arabic model terms in their Groq console (account gate, not a code bug). Provider selectable in Settings DONE (typecheck/lint/build + both verify green): the Settings panel (`components/ui/ai-chat.tsx`) now picks an **LLM provider** (Groq / OpenCode-local / 9Router / Mock) plus a model per provider. New `apps/web/src/lib/providers.ts` holds `PROVIDER_SPECS`, a client-safe `PUBLIC_PROVIDERS` (id/label/models only — never sections endpoints/keys), `isProviderId`, and server-only `resolveProvider(provider)` mapping id→(url,apiKey,defaultModel) from env: `groq`→`GROQ_API_KEY`+`GROQ_LLM_MODEL`; `opencode`→`OPENCODE_LLM_BASE`/`OPENCODE_LLM_KEY`/`OPENCODE_LLM_MODEL` (default `localhost:20128` / `open-code`, key optional `EMPTY`); `9router`→`LLM_API_BASE`/`LLM_API_KEY`/`LLM_MODEL`. `.git/` excluded. `mock`→no endpoint (route short-circuits: `/api/llm` streams a canned reply with zero network calls — token-free UI testing; `resolveProvider("mock")` returns `null` and is never called). `/api/llm` resolves via `resolveProvider` from the `body.provider` (default `groq`; unknown→`groq`), threads `url`/`apiKey`/`defaultModel` through `runOneCompletion`/`runAgent` replacing the old module-level `LLM_URL`/`LLM_KEY`/`MODEL` (removed). `GroqStreamingProvider` gained `setProvider(id)` and sends `body.provider`. `useVoice` exposes `provider`/`setProvider`/`providers`; switching provider resets the model to Auto. In the hook the live provider **instance** is `providerInstance` (the string state is `provider`) to avoid a name clash. Invariant 5 held: client sends only `{provider, model}`, never keys/endpoints. Key mapping lives in the table above; clear the stale `LLM_API_BASE=http://localhost:20128/v1` root-only config if you want `groq` to be the sole default (the old `LLM_*` envs now only feed the `9router` provider).

**BUG FIXED (ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE on /api/llm):** the browser sent `provider:"groq", model:"open-code"`; the old route used a global `MODEL = process.env.LLM_MODEL ?? ...` = the leftover `LLM_MODEL=<open-code>`, so every default Groq request went out with model `open-code` → Groq 404 → `runOneCompletion` threw → `controller.error()` → the response aborted with empty body → Chrome logged `net::ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE` (and a silent `error` event reached the UI). Root cause was the stale root `LLM_*` env bleeding into Groq. Fixed by the provider refactor: `defaultModel` is now per-provider (`groq`→`qwen/qwen3.8-27b`, independent of `LLM_MODEL`), and the client only sends `body.model` when a model is actually selected. Verified: `POST /api/llm` `{}` → 200; `{"provider":"groq","model":"open-code"}` → 000 (expected — Groq has no such model). Residual: typing/selecting a model a provider doesn't support still yields an empty-response fetch (the `error` event surfaces it); a custom/open misconfig (e.g. 9router→localhost:20128) behaves the same.

**DEV-SERVER GOTCHA (not code):** mid-edit hot-reloads corrupted `.next` webpack chunks → `Error: Cannot find module './819.js'` → **all** `/api/llm` (+ `_document`) routes 500 and returned an HTML error page, even `{"messages":[...]}` and mock. Persistent notes + full FR-014 risk set DONE (typecheck/lint/build/test green, both verify proofs pass, graph updated): the `save_note` demo store is no longer in-memory — `apps/web/src/lib/tools.ts` now persists notes to disk at `apps/web/.data/notes.json` (fixed constant path, never derived from user input → no path traversal; atomic write via temp-file + `renameSync`; capped at `MAX_NOTES=50` / `NOTE_BUDGET=80000` bytes; `readNotes` swallows corrupt/missing files → safely returns `[]`). Added `list_notes` (risk `read`) and `delete_note` (risk `delete`), so all FR-014 categories (read auto-runs; write/delete pause for `@@CONFIRM`) are exercised by real tools. File access tool DONE (typecheck/lint/build/test green, both verify proofs pass, graph updated): Phase-4 "File access" filled via a read-only `file_read` tool in `apps/web/src/lib/tools.ts`. It is `risk:"read"` (auto-runs server-side, no FR-014 confirmation). Sandbox: resolved relative to `process.cwd()` (repo root), rejects absolute/tilde paths, and after `resolve()` normalization requires the result stay within root (blocks `..` escapes); a deny-list of **path segments** (`.git`, `node_modules`, `.next`, `.data`, `dist`, `coverage`) plus **filename patterns** (`.env*`, `*.local`, `.key/.pem/.crt`, compiled artifacts) keeps API keys and build dirs out of the LLM context (invariant 5/security). Files return content (truncated at `FILE_MAX_BYTES=60000`), directories return a `type\tname` listing (capped 200). Added to `executeTool` dispatch + `/api/llm` SYSTEM_PROMPT tool list. `verify.ts` + a standalone probe confirmed: reading source works, listing works, and `.env.local` (direct + via `..`), absolute `/etc/passwd`, `~/.ssh/...`, `node_modules`, and root escape are all blocked. Notes: workspace root is fixed to `process.cwd()` (the Next server / repo root) — a dedicated read-only docs dir could be made configurable later, out of MVP scope.

Per-user isolation (auth-lite) DONE (typecheck/lint/build/test green, both verify proofs pass, graph updated): persona + notes are now isolated per user, keyed by the existing `voice-ai.user` (from localStorage) sent from the client. New `apps/web/src/lib/users.ts`: `sanitizeUser()` (only `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, ≤60, rejects `.`/`..`/empty — stops path traversal, invariant 5), `appRoot()`/`repoRoot()`/`userDataRoot()` (stable repo-root anchor so paths resolve identically whether the dev server runs with cwd=`apps/web` or the repo root — this fixed a latent cwd-dependent bug where notes/persona landed in `apps/web/apps/web/.data/`). `persona.ts` seeds a per-user persona at `apps/web/.data/users/<user>/persona/*.md` (copied from the shared `apps/web/persona` template on first use) and `loadPersonaPrompt`/`upsertPersonaFact` target it; `tools.ts` notes store per-user at `<user>/notes.json` (still falls back to shared `apps/web/.data/notes.json` when no user); `/api/llm` and `/api/persona` accept `user` and thread it through (incl. `executeTool(call, user)` in the agent loop and confirm continuation). `GroqStreamingProvider` gained `setUser(user)` and sends `user` in `/api/llm` + `/api/persona` bodies; `useVoice` syncs `historyUser()` onto the provider. Lib-to-lib imports use relative `./users` (not `@/lib/users`) so `verify.ts`/tsx proofs still run. Verified end-to-end: `city:Jakarta` written for `naufal` lands at `.data/users/naufal/persona/USER.md`, absent from `bob`s persona; sanitizer rejects `../evil`/spaces; global template not polluted. Note: this is identity (not authz) — anyone can claim any name; the gain is that facts/notes don't bleed across names. History stays per-user in localStorage.

TTS fallback (best-effort): `GroqStreamingProvider.speak()` no longer throws on TTS failure (429 rate limit, 5xx, network). It silently skips that sentence's audio while the assistant's text still streams to completion, so a throttled/expired Groq TTS quota (free tier 100 RPD) never surfaces as a raw 502 "Failed to load resource" or a hard error event to the UI. STT (`transcribe`) still reports errors (it's a live-input path the user should know about). Note: on 2026-09-02 the Groq TTS RPD limit (100/day) was exhausted → `/api/tts` returned 429 → proxied as 502 in the browser; this change makes that graceful.

Schedulers & reminders (Mia fitur) DONE (typecheck/lint/build/test green, both verify proofs pass, graph updated): per-user reminder store + scheduler + SSE push. New `apps/web/src/lib/reminders.ts` persists `{id,text,at,fired}` records per user at `.data/users/<user>/reminders.json` (sanitized user, atomic write, uncapped-at-40). `addReminder(text, atMs, rawUser)` and `takeDueReminders(rawUser)` (atomic mark-fired so each reminder delivers exactly once) + `subscribeReminders(listener)` feeding a lazily-started module-scoped interval (stop when no listeners). New tool `remind_me` (FR-014 `write` risk → confirmation) in `tools.ts` with `scheduleReminder()` that parses ISO-8601 `when` via `Date.parse`; added to SYSTEM_PROMPT. New `GET /api/reminders/stream?user=` SSE route (replays overdue on connect via takeDueReminders + live pushes + 20s keepalive; `cancel()` cleans up). `useVoice` opens an EventSource and exposes `reminders`/`dismissReminder` (queue capped 5); `AIChatCard` renders an amber "Reminder" banner with dismiss (Clock icon). End-to-end verified: due reminders fire as `data:` frames on connect and mark fired (reconnect delivers nothing). NOTES: (1) the scheduler is single-instance in-process (multi-instance deploys need an external queue — out of MVP); (2) a reminder that becomes due while NO stream is open stays unfired and is replayed on next connect (survives closed tab); (3) two serve-tests must use cwd-aware `appRoot()` anchoring (see users.ts) so paths match the dev server's cwd=`apps/web`.

**Recurring + varied reminders (2026-09-05, flood fix, typecheck/lint + reminder probe green):** `reminders.ts` `Reminder` now supports `repeat:"daily"`, `variants:string[]`, `variantIdx`. `addReminder(text, atMs, rawUser, {repeat?, variants?})` — a NEW daily reminder **merges into** an existing UNFIRED reminder at the same clock time (adopts/overwrites it and converts to daily). One-shots NEVER merge (two distinct one-shots at the same clock both fire). `takeDueReminders` now **reschedules a daily 24h ahead** (still unfired, `variantIdx+1`) and returns the rotated `variants[variantIdx % length]` text, while one-shots are marked fired — so "setiap hari jam 7" is ONE record firing daily instead of stacking duplicates. `reminderIntent.ts` detects `setiap hari/tiap hari/every day/daily/harian` → `repeat:"daily"` and `ganti(-)ganti/beda-beda/variasi/selang-seling` → `variants` (Mia-style pool). `agent.ts scheduleReminderFromIntent` + `tools.ts remind_me` (schema gained `repeat:"daily"` enum) thread opts through. **Root cause of the "notif banyak" flood:** the user asked repeatedly and every turn stacked a fresh one-shot at the next 07:00, so 4 reminders all fired at 07:00; opening the SSE stream or a chat then bursts all of them to Telegram+Discord owner. Fix = merge+reschedule above (probe-verified: 2 daily adds → 1 record; daily delivers A→B→C rotating, reschedules +24h; one-shot stays one-shot). Store cleaned for `naufalazhar652952` (now a single daily 07:00 wake with variants) and `naufal` (empty — was all test artifacts). **Multi-time compound asks DONE (2026-09-05):** `reminderIntent.ts` splits on clause boundaries (`dan`, `lalu`, `terus`, `,`) — "jam 1 siang ingetin makan siang, dan jam 8 malam ingetin makan malam" parses per-clause into TWO reminders (12:00 + 20:00), each carrying its own clause text; `parseClockTimes` (plural) extracts all clocks, `parseClockTime`/`detectReminderIntent` stay as single-first wrappers; `scheduleReminderFromIntent` loops the intents and joins the confirmation suffix ("pukul 12:00 dan 20:00"). Residual: a daily with no open stream at due time delivers once when a stream reconnects; multiple times inside ONE clause still resolve to that clause's first time.

BUG FIXED (TypeError on /api/llm confirm_call): calling a risky tool (remind_me/save_note/delete_note) that pauses for confirmation threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')` at route.ts and returned HTTP 500. Root cause was a client↔route contract mismatch on `confirm_call`: `GroqStreamingProvider` sent a flat `{ id, name, arguments, allow }`, but the route body type and code read `body.confirm_call.call` (a nested `ToolCall`). Fixed by (1) wrapping `confirm_call` to the declared `{ call: { id, name, arguments }, allow }` shape in `streamAssistantReply` (apps/web/src/ai/GroqStreamingProvider.ts), and (2) hardening the route to return 400 `"confirm_call requires a valid call"` instead of crashing when `call` is missing/invalid (apps/web/src/app/api/llm/route.ts). Verified live on groq: correct `{ call, allow:false }` → 200 (assistant replies "skipped"); flat legacy shape → 400 (not 500). typecheck/lint/build/test green.

Mood tracking (Mia suggestion 2026-09-05, typecheck/lint + mood probe green): per-user mood log so Mia records "kamu sedang butuh apa" and can tailor support. New `apps/web/src/lib/mood.ts` — fixed vocabulary `MOOD_VALUES` (great/good/okay/meh/stressed/anxious/sad/tired/angry) with IN-EN normalization ("capek"→tired, "bahagia"→great, unknown→meh), `addMood(mood, rawUser, note?)`/`readMoods`/`listMoods(since?)`/`moodTrend` at `.data/users/<user>/moods.json` (same atomic-write + sanitized-user pattern as tasks; capped `MAX_MOODS=200`, corrupt→[]). New tools `mood_log` (risk **read**, auto — takes mood + optional note) and `mood_recent` (risk **read**, auto — returns `moodTrend` + `listMoods` historial; used for "gimana mood-ku belakangan ini"). Deterministic capture `apps/web/src/lib/moodIntent.ts`: `detectMoodIntent(text)` regex-matches state-of-mind statements (stres/capek/sedih/cemas/marah/...), `logDetectedMood` writes via `addMood`; wired into **both** agent paths (`agent.ts logMoodFromMessages` after `scheduleReminderFromIntent` in the opencode branch and after the reminder block in the groq/9router branch) so moods log even when the model never emits a tool call. SYSTEM_PROMPT lists the tools + usage rule; OPENCODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT tells it to acknowledge mood (system records it automatically). Verified probe: normalize INT→EN, persistence round-trip, neutral queries → null, `logDetectedMood` writes; verify.ts + typecheck + lint green. **Live-verified on 9router (2026-09-05):** "aku lagi stres banget kerjaan numpuk" → entry `stressed` ditulis; "gimana mood-ku belakangan ini?" → model memanggil `mood_recent` & melaporkan akurat. BUG FIXED (double-log): `mood_log` tool (model) dan `logDetectedMood` (deterministik setelah turn) sama-sama menulis duplikat → `addMood` kini dedupe (entry bermood sama dalam `DEDUPE_WINDOW_MS`=10s dicollapse ke entry pertama; probe: tool+detect → 1 row, mood berbeda tetap append). Residual: trend adalah lightweight count heuristics (no ML); detection keyword-based — "stres" di luar konteks state bisa false-positive (probe netral → null); model 9router kadang menambah-nambahi count ("2 entri") padahal store 1 entri — data layer akurat, hanya embellishment LLM; no UI untuk mood history (ask via chat `mood_recent`).

**Spotify integration (2026-09-05, typecheck/lint + spotify probe + verify green):** lets Mia control the owner's playback via the Spotify Web API. `apps/web/src/lib/spotify.ts` — OAuth Authorization Code flow: `spotifyAuthUrl(user)` builds the authorize URL (SANITIZED user carried as `state`), `exchangeSpotifyCode` trades the code for a per-user refresh token stored at `.data/users/<user>/spotify.json` (atomic write; also `readSpotifyToken`/`clearSpotifyToken`), and every API call (`spotifyRequest`) auto-refreshes the short-lived access token (refresh on expiry or 401). Envs server-side only: `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID`/`SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` (+ `SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI`, default `http://localhost:3000/api/spotify/callback`) — must match the redirect registered in the Spotify dashboard exactly. Routes: `GET /api/spotify/auth?user=` (302→Spotify authorize; 500 when not configured) + `GET /api/spotify/callback?code=&state=` (exchange → redirect `/?spotify=connected|denied|error`). Tools (registry, `tools.ts`): `spotify_link` (read, returns connect URL or "sudah terhubung"), `spotify_status`/`spotify_search`/`spotify_devices` (read, auto-run), `spotify_play`/`spotify_pause`/`spotify_next`/`spotify_previous`/`spotify_volume` (write, FR-014 confirm). Shared `spotifyToolError` maps `spotify_not_connected`→ auth link, `spotify_no_active_device`→ "buka Spotify dulu" (player endpoints 404 with no active device). IMPORTANT: **playback-control endpoints require a Spotify Premium account** (status/search/devices work on free). SYSTEM_PROMPT tool list + usage + no-wait list updated; `verify.ts` checks registrations + not-connected path; spotify probe verified auth-URL building, token store, and not-connected messages. Residual: OAuth needs the owner to open `spotifyAuthUrl` once in a browser (no in-app popup); `spotify_link` in a voice turn returns a URL (not spoken well — text channels best); no device selection before play (uses active device).

Multi-session / resumable history (Mia fitur) DONE (typecheck/lint/build/test green, both verify proofs pass): builds on FR-015 to give each user multiple named, resumable conversations stored server-side (consistent with notes/reminders/persona isolation). New `apps/web/src/lib/sessions.ts` persists per-user sessions at `.data/users/<user>/sessions/<id>.json` + a lightweight `index.json` (SessionMeta: id/title/updatedAt/turns) capped at MAX_SESSIONS=12 (newest first); `upsertSession` (atomic index rewrite), `listSessions`, `loadSession` (full conversation), `deleteSession`. New `apps/web/src/app/api/sessions/route.ts`: `GET ?user=` (list), `GET ?user=&id=` (one, 404 if missing), `POST {user, session_id?, conversation, title?}` (upsert → {id}), `DELETE {user, session_id}`. OpenCode native streaming DONE (2026-09-02, typecheck/lint/build/test + both verify proofs green): the `opencode` provider now talks to the user's local `opencode serve` (default `http://127.0.0.1:4096`, set `OPENCODE_SERVER_BASE`) via its **proprietary session/agent API**, not OpenAI-compatible HTTP — fixing the old circular self-proxy (`OPENCODE_LLM_BASE=http://localhost:20128/v1/chat/completions` pointed at the voice app's own next-server, empty `open-code` replies). It streams **only the assistant reply text**: captures `assistantMessageID` from `message.updated` (role=assistant) and diffs `message.part.updated` text parts whose `messageID` matches (the prompt's own text parts arrive as text parts too and would otherwise be emitted as the answer). Robustness backstops: (1) hard `OPENCODE_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 60000) watchdog aborts the session if the agent stalls; (2) any `permission.updated` is auto-**rejected** via `POST /session/:id/permissions/:id` so a tool-permission prompt can never hang the turn (no confirmation UI in a voice turn; the assistant's own tools already go through FR-014); (3) temp session is `DELETE`d in `finally` (no session bloat). `/api/llm/route.ts` short-circuits `providerId === "opencode"` **before** `resolveProvider`/model validation (bypassing the old proxy env) with its own `OPENCODE_SYSTEM_PROMPT` + `buildOpenCodeSystemPrompt(rawUser)` (still loads persona) and streams deltas through the same `text/plain` emitter — client (`GroqStreamingProvider`/`useVoice`/`ConversationManager`/`AIProvider`) is **completely unchanged**. System prompt firmly forbids OpenCode executing its own tools (write/bash would stall or surprise mid-turn); persona `<persona>` live-updates still apply. `providers.ts` opencode spec updated (description "Native local opencode agent", model label "Auto (server default)"); `.env.example` updated (old `OPENCODE_LLM_*` removed). Verified live: single-turn factual → 200 streamed; prior-context → 200 "Naufal" (previously HUNG on a tool permission); mock provider regression still 200. Note OpenCode server must be running (`nohup opencode serve --port 4096 &`), unauthenticated local REST/SSE only (no WS endpoint exists). Both the web route and the bot import it directly (no HTTP-to-self). `/api/llm/route.ts` is now a thin wrapper mapping errors → status (invalid model 400, not-configured 500, LLM error 502) + streaming. New `apps/web/src/channels/telegram.ts` (grammY): starts via Next instrumentation — `instrumentation.ts` dispatcher (`NEXT_RUNTIME==="nodejs"` → `await import("./instrumentation-node")`) → `instrumentation-node.ts` calls `startTelegramBot()` **fire-and-forget** (`void bot.start(...).catch(...)` — NEVER `await bot.start()` inside `register`, it never resolves and blocks server readiness so GET / hangs; compact `notFound()` pattern avoided). Bot features: chat-history per chat, commands `/start /help /reset /provider /model`, **allow-list owner** via `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERNAME` (default `naufalazhar65`), risky-tool inline confirm ("Balas 'ya'/'tidak'"), reminder push to owner chat via `subscribeReminders`. Builder gotchas: Next 15 ignores the `.node.ts` naming convention — use ONE `instrumentation.ts` with the edge/node dispatcher; `bot.start()` fire-and-forget to avoid blocking readiness. Env (`.env.local`, git-ignored): `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_USERNAME`, `TELEGRAM_PROVIDER` (default `groq`; the bot can't read the browser's localStorage provider), `TELEGRAM_USER` (sanitized user key for notes/reminders/persona), optional `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`. BUG FIXED (reminder scheduled in the past): Groq's model emitted `when:"2026-05-28T13:00"` for "jam 1 siang" (5 months stale — the model has no live clock). Fixes: (1) `buildSystemPrompt` (and the refactored `currentTimeLine()` helper now shared with the OpenCode prompt) injects the current local date+time and instructs the model that a bare clock time = TODAY (or TOMORROW if passed), never invent a date; (2) safety net in `scheduleReminder` (`tools.ts`): any `Date.parse` result in the past rebases to `nextOccurrence(hour,minute)` so a relative reminder never fires immediately. Verified: re-ask → `when:"2026-09-03T13:00:00+07:00"` (correct), reminder row `fired:false` landed on disk. Verified end-to-end: hello/persona ("Naufal"), `remind_me` confirm "ya"/"tidak", `/help`, reminder delivery. Residual: bot is long-poll + in-process (single instance; multi-node needs external queue); non-owner chats are ignored; reminders only deliver if the bot process is up at due time.

OPS GOTCHA — "AI tidak merespons" / long hang on opencode (2026-09-03): the `opencode` provider's LLM backend is opencode serve (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` models `9router/ngoding` → baseURL `http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1`). When that local 9router proxy is DOWN, opencode serve loops `AI_APICallError: Cannot connect to API` retries for a full turn — `/api/llm` still returns HTTP 200 but only after 30–400s, so the browser/curl (short timeout) aborts first and you see `net::ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE` / `HTTP:000` with an empty reply = "AI doesn't respond". This is NOT a code bug. Fix: ensure the 9router proxy is running (`lsof -ti tcp:20128` non-empty) and `opencode serve --port 4096` is up; both must be UP or text/voice hang. Also: there can be TWO `opencode serve` processes colliding on global state — kill all (`pkill -f "opencode serve"`) and start exactly one (`nohup opencode serve --port 4096 --print-logs > /tmp/opencode-serve.log 2>&1 &`). Groq text bypasses this entirely (fast, ~600ms); switch the app provider to Groq if you want zero dependency on the local proxy. Quick triage: `lsof -ti tcp:20128`, `lsof -ti tcp:4096`, `lsof -ti tcp:3000` — all three should be UP.

**Quality fixes (mood/reminder/spotify, user-reported):** (1) 9router wrote tool calls as PROSE (`mood_log(...)`, `remind_me(...)`) that leaked into chat → `stripToolCallProse()` in agent.ts removes tool-call-looking lines (fence-aware, all providers) — **critical ordering: strip runs BEFORE the deterministic post-processors** (a prose `remind_me(...)` containing "remind" used to suppress the reminder confirm-suffix, then got stripped → bare "…" reply even though the reminder WAS scheduled). (2) Telegraphic mood/greeting replies ("Beb lelah. Hari berat.") → `ensureMoodReplyQuality()`: if the message is a mood/greeting turn and every sentence is ≤4 words, replace with a warm deterministic empathy line (rotated daily; mood variants per mood label). Lesson: prompt BAD-examples get imitated by small models — rules must be described, never quoted; telegraphic junk was also scrubbed from daily memory (self-priming via RAG recall). (3) Indonesian clock: "jam 1 siang" = 13:00 (was 12:00); bare clocks ("jam 8 pas") resolve to the NEAREST FUTURE interpretation (`nearestOccurrence`) so an evening ask never lands on tomorrow morning. **Deterministic mood capture & telegraphic guard (2026-09-07, agentic quality):** `ensureMoodReplyQuality` covers mood AND greeting turns (detectMoodIntent / greeting regex incl. "sayang", excluding clock/reminder asks), rewrite only when the reply is telegraphic (all sentences ≤4 words), variants rotate by day. Live-verified on GLM 5.2: "capek banget hari ini" → warm full-sentence empathy.

**Gotchas learned (2026-09-07):**
- **tsx probes do NOT load `.env.local`** (only `next dev` does) — probes needing provider env must parse `.env.local` manually into `process.env` before importing lib modules.
- **Deterministic post-processing ORDER matters**: strip prose before suffix decisions; a tool-call-looking model reply both matches "remind" (suppressing the suffix) and gets stripped → empty reply.
- **Never quote BAD examples in prompts** — small models imitate them verbatim (telegraphic mood replies appeared right after a GOOD/BAD prompt edit).
- **Self-priming via RAG**: bad replies stored in daily memory get recalled into later prompts — scrub junk lines from the record when fixing output quality.
- **macOS storage**: `df /` = sealed system snapshot (~40% always); the honest number is `/System/Volumes/Data`.
- **Strict gateways** (OpenCode Go) reject non-standard fields anywhere in the request (tools[].risk) — serialize standard OpenAI schema only.
- **Telegram typing** is best-effort UI: some clients don't render bot typing; keep it (cheap) but don't rely on it as the only waiting signal.

## Session 2026-09-17 (format push reminder) — kalimat penutup nyempil

Owner melaporkan push reminder terasa aneh:
`🌸 Mia — Mas Naufal, udah makan siang belum? Jangan skip ya 😄 · pukul 12:12` lalu baris kedua `Pelan-pelan aja, aku di sini`.

Akar masalahnya bukan satu kalimat, tapi **desain templating**: `reminderMessage` membungkus SEMUA teks reminder dengan template (`{text}`, `Beb, {text} 🌸`, `saatnya {text} 🌸`, `{text}, yuk.`), menambahkan TAILS acak, lalu membuang 🌸. Untuk kalimat utuh hasil model ini menghasilkan omong kosong (tercetak saat audit): `"saatnya Bangun tidur Mas Naufal!"`, `"…belum? Jangan skip ya 😄, yuk."`, `"Beb, Mas Naufal, udah makan siang belum?…"`, `"Beb, Isi perut dulu ya…"`.

Perbaikan (menyederhanakan, bukan menambah aturan):
- **Kalimat utuh dipakai APA ADANYA** (tanpa template, tanpa TAILS — satu baris).
- Template hanya untuk **teks pendek** (`isTerseReminder`: ≤2 kata tanpa tanda baca/emoji, mis. "makan"/"minum air"), dan selalu memilih varian yang menutup sendiri (`hasOwnCloser`).
- TAILS dihapus seluruhnya; 🌸 tetap satu (dari wrapper channel), jam tetap 24-jam WIB.
- Helper murni `hasOwnCloser`/`isTerseReminder` + tes (total `vitest` 27 tes) yang mengunci: keluaran satu baris, tanpa template untuk kalimat utuh, tanpa "Pelan-pelan/Semangat".

## Session 2026-09-17 (verbatim hijack) — balasan tertimpa daftar reminder

Owner mengirim "halo" tapi menerima balasan daftar reminder. Reproduksi menunjukan rantai sebenarnya: pada **"ingetin aku makan siang ya nanti jam 12"** model memanggil `reminders_list` (untuk konteks), dan **verbatim fast-path** (`VERBATIM_LIST`) mengganti SELURUH balasan Mia dengan output tool mentah → user tidak pernah dapat konfirmasi, dan intent `remind_me` yang belum tuntas "bocor" ke pesan berikutnya (muncul prompt konfirmasi lain di giliran "halo"). Penjadwalan deterministik sebenarnya tetap berjalan (suffix `(terjadwal)`), tapi balasannya menyesatkan.

Perbaikan: gate di `agent.ts` — fast-path hanya menimpa balasan bila **user memang meminta daftar itu**:
- `userAskedForList(tool, userText)` (pure, tested): tool daftar **personal** (`reminders_list`, `list_tasks`, `list_notes`, `calendar_list`, `plan_list`, `gmail_*`, `hotel_search`, `persona_show`, …) hanya menimpa bila pesan user memuat kata daftar/status (`LIST_ASK_RE`) dan bukan permintaan SET (`SET_VERB_RE`), kecuali ada permintaan eksplisit "apa aja/daftar/lihat/cek" ("ingetin aku, reminder apa aja yang aktif?" → tetap daftar).
- Tool task/security (recon, finding, poc, suite_hunt, …) tetap selalu menimpa — outputnya memang deliverable-nya, dan sapaan tidak mungkin memicunya.
Verifikasi: "ingetin aku makan siang jam 12" → balasan konfirmasi normal (tidak ada daftar), "halo" → sapaan, "reminder kamu apa aja?" → daftar verbatim (masih benar).

## Session 2026-09-17 (double-turn) — satu pesan diproses DUA kali

Owner menerima **dua prompt konfirmasi `remind_me`** untuk satu pesan "ingetin aku makan siang jam 12". Log menunjukkan pesan Discord yang sama di-handle dua kali (`msg … / turn start / turn done` dua kali) dan Telegram mencatat `409 Conflict: terminated by other getUpdates request` = **ada instance kedua hidup** saat itu (prosedur restart lama `pkill -f "next dev"` + `sleep 3` tidak menjamin anak `next-server` mati sebelum instance baru start).

Perbaikan (kelas bug: inbound message / start runner harus "sekali per PROSES"):
- **`lib/once.ts`** — primitif process-wide di `globalThis` (module-level `let` di-reset oleh HMR sehingga guard/start bisa lahir dua kali): `alreadyProcessed(kind, id)` (dedupe pesan masuk, ring 500 id) + `alreadyStarted(key)`/`resetStarted(key)`.
- **Discord**: `alreadyProcessed("discord", msg.id)` di awal handler (duplikat di-log `duplicate message ignored`, bukan diproses) + dedupe `interaction.id`.
- **Telegram**: satu middleware `bot.use(...)` mendedupe via `ctx.update.update_id` (menutup semua tipe pesan: text/voice/document/photo).
- **Guard start** bot + seluruh runner (heartbeat, briefing, weekly, recap, winddown, context, auto-updater, automation-runner) kini `alreadyStarted(...)` — HMR tidak bisa menambah timer/client kedua (dulu bisa → push dobel).
- **Prosedur restart** di AGENTS diperbaiki: kill **per port** + tunggu port bebas (lihat HABIT di atas), lalu verifikasi `grep -c "logged in as"` = 1 dan tidak ada 409.

Verifikasi setelah perbaikan: start log berisi tepat satu `logged in as`, satu `[telegram] starting`, **0** 409, dan setiap runner log `starting —` sekali. `vitest` +`once.test.ts` (dedupe window/cap + guard idempotence) → 24 tes.

## Session 2026-09-17 — honesty/integrity fixes found from live pushes

Owner pasted a day of real pushes ("apa ada yang aneh?") — five root-caused fixes, all verified against real data:

1. **Wrong-location weather (highest impact).** `weather.ts` geocoded the raw label: `weather("Lake Home, Serpong, Tangerang Selatan (koordinat -6.378806,106.712563)")` → `Cannot get coords` (anchored parser) and bare `weather("Lake Home")` → wttr.in resolved a DIFFERENT place (25°C/80%) while the real Serpong was 31°C/52% — so 01:57/03:57 pushes reported another region's weather under the user's own nickname. Fix: `parseLatLonAnywhere` (bounded lookbehind/lookahead so "2026, 17" can't match, pure/tested) + `homeCoordsFor` (persona `home` label → `home_coords`, generic words like home/kota excluded so unrelated queries aren't hijacked) + when explicit coords are known, wttr is fetched BY COORDS (a name fetch could resolve elsewhere) while the human label stays the user's own. Prompt rule: on `Cannot get coords`, NEVER report another location. `getWeather(loc, rawUser)` now takes the user (tool plugin passes `ctx.rawUser`).
2. **Fabricated "kemarin kerasa capek dan berat".** `proactive.ts` fired its heavy openers whenever ANY negative mood existed, while `briefing.ts` required `neg > pos` → the same morning said both "kemarin lumayan cerah, seneng" and "kemarin kerasa capek dan berat". Fix: `moodTone()` in `mood.ts` (NEGATIVE_MOODS/POSITIVE_MOODS + tie = neutral — one definition, pure/tested) used by BOTH; proactive uses heavy openers only on `negative`, a neutral opener on a tie, and stays silent on `positive`/no data.
3. **Briefing tie** → neutral line ("Kemarin naik-turun ya beb") instead of the positive one.
4. **Overlapping weather automations** (owner data): the leftover 12h "cuaca Jakarta" automation was DISABLED and the home one moved from every-2h to every-6h. New runner contract: `isSilentAutomationReply()` (pure/tested) — a scheduled CHECK replies exactly `SKIP` when there is nothing to report and the runner then pushes nothing (previously it pushed "tidak ada tanda hujan" at 01:57 and 03:57).
5. **Filler leaked as a "topic" + reminder formatting.** `isFillerLine()` in `memoryNoise.ts` (pure/tested) drops pure small-talk ("alooo beb") from the briefing snippet, the proactive snippet and the weekly theme counter. `clockLabel()` in `replyChunk.ts` gives ONE 24-hour WIB "HH:MM" for both channels (was `toLocaleTimeString([])` → "· pukul 06:00 AM"), and `reminderMessage` no longer prepends "saatnya" to a greeting and strips 🌸 so the channel wrapper's single signature flower isn't duplicated.

(1) The tool-confirmation prompt rendered every arg verbatim, so a `rapyd_request` secret_key / `jwt_attack` secret / `breach_check` password / `Authorization`+`Cookie` header showed up in Discord/Telegram — `redactArgsForDisplay` (in `args.ts`, recursive, key-based + pattern) masks those values while keeping the keys. (2) The audit log redacted only 5 tool names, so `http_request`/`jwt_attack`/`http_session`/`cdp_request` wrote JWTs and the auth0 id into `.data/audit/*.log` — logging now masks by KEY for every tool (`redactArgsForDisplay`) and `redactSecrets` also handles `rsk_`/`rak_` and JSON `"secretKey": "…"` values. ## Session 2026-09-17 — FreeRide audit: failover yang tak pernah jalan

Audit live menemukan dua cacat yang membuat janji FreeRide (fallback saat free model kena limit) tidak pernah terpicu:

1. **Error in-band dianggap sukses.** OpenRouter/Groq melaporkan model mati/kepenuhan sebagai **HTTP 200 + `{"error":{...}}`** (`data: {"error":{"code":503,"message":"Upstream error from Nvidia…"}}`) — bukan HTTP error. `runOneCompletionOnce` dulu hanya membaca `choices[0].delta`, jadi frame itu dilewati → `text=""` tanpa exception → chain tidak failover dan user dapat balasan kosong. Kini `parseStreamError` (exported, pure, di `agent.ts`) mendeteksi error pada frame `data:` **dan** body JSON mentah (gateway yang mengabaikan `stream:true`), lalu melempar `Provider error (code): message`.
2. **Klasifikasi retry terlalu sempit.** Chain hanya fallback pada `/429|rate limit|quota/`. Kini memakai `isProviderRetryable` (`assistantError.ts`, pure, tested) = rate limit + provider/upstream 5xx + overload + model pensiun (`not a valid model`/`no allowed providers`/404) + ECONNRESET/timeout. Error yang bukan milik provider (argumen tool, kode) sengaja TIDAK memicu chain.
3. **Watcher/rotate tidak benar-benar memprobe.** `freerideWatcherOnce` hanya memprobe bila id berawalan `openrouter/` — padahal chain nyatanya `nvidia/*:free` → selalu "OK (no probe needed)" palsu; `freerideRotate` menilai hidup dari `res.ok` saja, sehingga model yang menjawab `200 + error` tetap dipertahankan. Kini keduanya memakai **satu** keputusan `isProbeAliveResponse(status, body)` (2xx **dan** tanpa `error` **dan** ada `choices`) + `probeOpenRouterModel` (id dipakai apa adanya — `openrouter/free` adalah id asli, bukan prefix yang boleh dipotong). Sekalian membuang dead code `rankedIds` di `freerideAuto`.

Bukti: unit `llmStream.test.ts` (12 tes) — frame error 502/429/400, body JSON mentah, retry-429-lalu-sukses, klasifikasi retry, `isProbeAliveResponse`; live E2E `runAssistantTurn` provider `openrouter` dengan model mati (`google/gemini-2.0-flash-001` → 404) **failover ke `nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free` dan membalas "Halo 🌸"** (log `[freeride] … failed … trying …`); watcher live: primary sehat → `alive`, primary bohong → `failed + rotated`. Gates: typecheck, lint (0 temuan baru), vitest 39/39, `verify.ts` EXIT=0. State `.data/freeride/` dikembalikan seperti semula setelah probe. Residual: probe/rotate memakai satu tembakan per model — model yang *flaky* bisa ikut dibuang (chain dipulihkan oleh `freeride_auto`); provider di luar OpenRouter/9router tetap tidak memakai chain (sesuai guard).

### Lanjutan — audit teliti #2 (kelas-bug yang sama + risiko yang dibuka oleh fix)

Audit kedua menemukan 5 hal lagi:

1. **Frame terakhir tanpa newline dibuang.** Loop hanya memproses baris yang diakhiri `\n`, jadi error yang datang sebagai frame terakhir tanpa newline (umum untuk body JSON mentah) tetap hilang → balasan kosong. Kini isi `buffer` sisa diproses setelah loop; logika per-baris diekstrak jadi `handleLine` (dipakai untuk baris penuh **dan** sisa buffer).
2. **Failover bisa MENGGANDAKAN efek nyata.** Chain me-retry seluruh `runAgent` dengan `messages` yang sama; kalau attempt pertama sudah menjalankan tool (mis. `spotify_play`) lalu completion lanjutannya gagal in-band, model kedua bisa menjalankannya lagi + riwayat tool dua model tertumpuk. Kini `chainMayFailover(messagesBefore, messagesAfter)` (pure, tested) — failover hanya bila attempt itu belum menyentuh `messages` (= mati di completion pertama). Efeknya: error setelah tool jalan dilaporkan apa adanya, bukan diulang.
3. **Tidak ada batas waktu chain.** Tiap member bisa menghabiskan retry 429 sendiri (6s), jadi outage free-tier bisa menahan satu turn ~40s. Kini `CHAIN_DEADLINE_MS = 30_000` (pure constant) → setelah lewat, error asli dilempar (lebih jujur daripada seolah hang).
4. **Probe watcher membakar kuota yang sama dengan turn nyata.** Setelah watcher benar-benar memprobe, tick 60s = 1440 probe/hari dari kuota free-model (OpenRouter: ~20/menit, cap harian rendah) → justru bisa membuat chain-nya sendiri kena limit. Kini `shouldProbeNow(lastProbeAt)` (pure, tested) membatasi probe asli ke **1×/jam** (`PROBE_MIN_INTERVAL_MS`, disimpan sebagai `lastProbeAt`; tetap ditulis saat gagal supaya primary mati dicek per jam, bukan per menit). README + `MIA_FEATURES.md` diperbarui.
5. **Status watcher tidak jujur + contoh id tool salah.** `freeride_status` membaca `lastCheck` saja → probe yang GAGAL tetap tertulis "alive"; kini melaporkan `status` + `lastProbeAt`. Deskripsi tool `freeride_switch` mencontohkan `openrouter/qwen/qwen3-coder:free` (id palsu — `openrouter/` bukan prefix yang boleh ditambah); kini menunjuk id apa adanya dari `freeride_list`.

Bukti tambahan: `llmStream.test.ts` 19 tes (tambah: error frame terakhir tanpa newline, tanpa-error tetap sukses, `chainMayFailover`, `shouldProbeNow`); `verify.ts` blok baru "freeride (in-band error failover + probe honesty + probe throttle): OK" (termasuk stream tiruan yang membuktikan error in-band melempar + 7 tool terdaftar); live: watcher → `"skip — diprobe 0m lalu (interval 60m)"` dengan `lastProbeAt` tidak berubah. Gates: typecheck, lint (0 temuan baru), vitest 46/46, `verify.ts` EXIT=0.

### Lanjutan — audit A+B: satu celah kredensial nyata ditemukan & ditutup

Audit "sudah maksimal?" atas A+B menemukan **kebocoran di perbaikan sendiri**: `ato_prove` menerima `body_template`, dan bila model menaruh password mentah di situ (atau menempel body login), nilainya **tidak dimask** — `redactArgsForDisplay` hanya memask berdasarkan NAMA KUNCI (`body_template` bukan kunci sensitif), dan `redactSecrets` tidak punya aturan untuk `pass=`/`password:`/`user:pass`. Akibatnya password bisa masuk **prompt konfirmasi kanal, audit log, dan daily memory**. Bukti: `redactArgsForDisplay({"body_template":"user=admin&pass=K0h0na…"})` → password utuh; `redactSecrets("user=admin&pass=K0h0na…")` → utuh.

Perbaikan: `redactSecrets` dapat aturan **assignment** yang mempertahankan kunci+separator dan hanya memask nilainya — `\b((?:pass(?:word|wd)?|pwd|secret|credential)s?[\s\\"']*[=:][\s\\"']*)[^"'\s,;]+` → `$1[redacted]` — sehingga prosa biasa tidak rusak ("Password minimal 8 karakter" tetap utuh), JSON tetap valid (`{"password":"[redacted]","note":"ok"}`), dan prompt konfirmasi bersih. Diuji di blok `verify.ts` "secret redaction (… + credentials)" untuk `credential`, `password`, `body_template` (form & JSON), plus anti-false-positive prosa.

Hasil audit lainnya (semua lolos): `isOwnLabTarget` 17 kasus batas — localhost/127/::1/10.x/192.168.x/172.16-31/env+subdomain = own lab; **172.32, example.com, host engagement, demo publik (scanme/testphp), `127.0.0.1.nip.io`, dan metadata cloud `169.254.169.254`/`100.100.100.200` = BUKAN** (guard SSRF utuh); `autoApproveAllowed` → lab `true`, demo & metadata `false`. `ato_prove` live di lab: login 200 tanpa cookie → verdict jujur "TANPA SESI" (bukan klaim takeover). Catatan: policy bersifat **owner-level** (berlaku untuk semua kanal/user bot ini) dan `suite_hunt`/`security_hunt` sengaja TIDAK di daftar auto-approve (tetap konfirmasi).

### Lanjutan — full pentest kini jalan dalam SATU turn (tanpa prompt, tanpa hijack)

Owner melaporkan `security_hunt` **masih** minta konfirmasi (memang sengaja tidak ikut daftar pertama). Setelah dinaikkan, ketemu dua penyebab lain yang membuat alur tetap berhenti:

1. **Verbatim hijack pada tool kerja.** `VERBATIM_LIST` memuat ~78 tool security, jadi tool PERTAMA yang jalan (hunt/poc_verify/…) langsung menggantikan balasan dan **mengakhiri turn** — alur full pentest tak mungkin berantai. Kini `VERBATIM_LIST = PERSONAL_LIST_TOOLS + {hardening_plan, writeup}`: output mentah hanya menimpa balasan bila user MEMINTA daftar itu (ask-gated) atau itu dokumen jadi. Seluruh tool kerja (recon_*, suite_hunt, poc_verify, param_fuzz, js_mine, …) jadi konteks → agent bisa lanjut scan → probe → prove → report.
2. **Markup DSML bocor + scrap `<`.** Model OpenCode Go kadang menulis pemanggilan tool sebagai teks bergaya DeepSeek (`｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke …`) yang hanya terpotong sebagian: `stripToolCallProse` kini menghapus blok DSML dan **sisa scrap** (`^[\s<>|｜/]+`), dan ada `isEffectivelyEmpty()` (tanpa alfanumerik = kosong) supaya sisa `<` tidak lagi mematikan guard jawaban-kosong (gejala: balasan cuma `"< (Link-nya udah masuk daftar bacaan…)"`).

Policy auto-approve juga diperluas ke rantai kerja (hunt/discovery/probe/proof/record + `policy_show`); scanner berat tetap manual. **Bukti live (prompt Discord persis)**: 5 ronde tool (pentest_resources/hunt_log → finding_list → web_audit/csp_audit/content_discover/poc_verify/cors_audit → poc_verify×3 → **report_pdf**) dengan **0 prompt, 0 bocor markup**, balasan berupa daftar temuan rapi + PDF. Gates: typecheck, vitest **84/84** (+2 tes scrap/DSML), `verify.ts` EXIT=0, lint baseline 39.

## Session 2026-09-17 (lanjutan) — list Discord tetap jadi satu paragraf: scrubber menelan newline

Setelah prompt/hint diperbaiki, balasan Mia **sudah bernomor tapi tetap satu paragraf**. Penyebab sebenarnya ada di **outbound scrubber**, bukan di model: `replyChunk.ts` `scrubToolMarkup` memakai `t.replace(/\s{2,}/g, " ")` — `\s` termasuk newline, jadi **setiap baris kosong antar item list diubah menjadi spasi** ("1. …\n\n2. …" → "1. … 2. …"). Setiap balasan Discord/Telegram lewat `chunkText` → kena. Bukti: `scrubToolMarkup("…\n\n1. …\n\n2. …")` → satu baris.

Perbaikan: hanya spasi/tab yang dirapatkan (`[ \t]{2,}` → " "), newline dipertahankan, baris kosong dibatasi maksimal dua (`\n{3,}` → `\n\n`). Tag-removal gap tetap dirapikan. Test baru: list ber-baris-kosong tidak diratakan + double space/tag gap tetap bersih (`turnRouting.test.ts`, total **65 tes**). Bukti live: balasan model 9 baris → lewat `chunkText` (jalur Discord) tetap **9 baris** (satu temuan per baris), bukan satu paragraf.

Hardening yang tetap dikerjakan (kelas bug: approved batch dituduh "not selected"):

Hasil tool kini **di-anchor ke pesan assistant yang MENDEKLARASIKAN id yang di-approve**, bukan ke pesan assistant terakhir (dulu `[...messages].reverse().find(...tool_calls)`) — kalau keduanya berbeda, batch yang baru di-approve bisa ditandai "Not selected" dan model lalu menyuruh user approve ulang. Owner punya lab latihan publik: `https://6a90ef33c41c07dd3335811e--cozy-kangaroo-42f2e0.netlify.app` (portal desa fiktif, API-nya memang sengaja rentan: `/api/cek-nik?id=` IDOR, `/api/dokumen` + `/api/dokumen/<id>` akses dokumen internal tanpa auth, `/api/pengaduan` stored XSS, `/api/login`). Bukti: `isLabTarget`/`targetAllowed` true untuk lab, `example.com` tetap false; live Mia `web_audit` + `http_request` ke lab mengembalikan data nyata.

**BUG BESAR yang ketemu saat latihan itu (bukan khas lab):** `LLM failed (400): ... The 'reasoning_content' in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API.` — model thinking (DeepSeek v4.x di OpenCode Go) menolak request lanjutan kalau reasoning-nya tidak dikembalikan. 1. `runOneCompletionOnce` kini ikut mengumpulkan `delta.reasoning_content` (dan `delta.reasoning` gaya OpenRouter) → `runOneCompletion` mengembalikan `reasoning`; `runAgent` menempelkannya sebagai `reasoning_content` pada pesan assistant ber-tool_calls **hanya untuk endpoint OpenCode Go** (gateway strict lain menolak field tak dikenal).
2. **Jalur web/HTTP**: reasoning itu hanya hidup di server, sedangkan klien yang mengirim ulang konteks — jadi frame `@@CONFIRM` kini bisa berbentuk `{ calls, reasoning }` (masih array biasa bila tak ada reasoning = back-compat). `GroqStreamingProvider` menerima dua bentuk, menyimpan `pendingReasoning`, dan menempelkannya pada pesan assistant yang ia bangun di `confirmTool`. 3. `POST /api/llm` kini juga menerima `confirm_calls` (batch) — sebelumnya hanya `confirm_call` (singular), padahal agent mendukung keduanya (dipakai channel); route adalah jalur API/web jadi parity-nya dilengkapi.

Gates: typecheck, `npm test` **53/53** (2 tes baru: reasoning `reasoning_content` + `reasoning` gaya OpenRouter), `verify.ts` EXIT=0, lint 0 temuan baru. Docs: `.env.example` (PENTEST_LAB_TARGETS + jebakan host preview Netlify).

## Session 2026-09-17 — pentest hardening: kapabilitas mati dibenahi, CVSS v4.0, 4 playbook

Audit sisi cybersec menemukan dua kapabilitas yang **dijanjikan prompt tapi tidak bisa jalan** di mesin ini, plus dua celah standar:

1. **`zap_scan` mati total** (butuh Docker; Docker tidak terpasang) dan gagalnya baru ketahuan setelah spawn. Kini `zapScan` mengecek `docker --version` lebih dulu (`runCapture` yang sudah ada) dan mengembalikan pesan jujur + padanan **native** (`web_audit`, `security_hunt`, `pentest_scan tool=nuclei`, `cors_audit`/`csp_audit`) alih-alih error generik; scope tetap ditegakkan. Deskripsi tool ikut menyebut hal ini.
2. **`pentest_scan tool=whatweb` selalu gagal** (`whatweb` tidak terpasang) padahal repo sudah punya fingerprint native. Logika `detectTech` diekstrak ke **`techFingerprint.ts`** (dipakai bersama `techWatch.ts` — satu definisi, bukan salinan kedua) + `fetchFingerprint(url)`; saat biner `whatweb` ENOENT, `pentestScan` jatuh ke `nativeFingerprint()` dan tetap mengembalikan hasil berguna.
3. **CVSS v4.0** (standar FIRST saat ini) kini didukung **tanpa dependency**. Percobaan `npm install` sebuah library v4 **dibatalkan**: repo ini punya konflik peer lama (react 18 vs 19) dan install mengacak `package-lock.json` (+1860/−100 baris, react root turun ke 18.3.1) — jadi vendor lokal dinilai lebih aman. `cvssV4.ts` mengimplementasikan MacroVector (EQ1–EQ6) + severity-distance persis spesifikasi, dengan data standar di `cvssV4Data.ts` (tabel lookup 270 baris + max-composed + depth). **Verifikasi: 0 mismatch vs implementasi referensi pada 3000 vektor acak** + anchor resmi (10/9.3/0/1/5.4). Diintegrasikan lewat **satu pintu** `cvssScoreAny(vector)` (dispatch `CVSS:4.0` → v4, sisanya v3.1 lama) sehingga `cvss_score`, `platform_severity`, dan `report` otomatis menerima vektor v4. `cvss4MacroVector` + `parseV4Vector` menolak vektor cacat dengan pesan jelas.
4. **4 playbook orisinal** (bukan adaptasi Strix, ditulis sendiri): `vulnerabilities/web-cache-poisoning.md`, `websocket-security.md`, `account-takeover.md`, `host-header-injection.md` — masing-masing dengan Mia tool mapping (oast/poc_verify/http_session/hunt_log). Playbook dir-driven → langsung muncul di katalog `security_playbook` (total **82** pack; `find` menghitung 83 karena `security-playbooks/README.md` bukan pack).

Bukti: `apps/web/src/lib/cvssV4.test.ts` (5 tes: anchor, 0-impact, monotonicitas AV, penolakan vektor cacat, macrovector); blok `verify.ts` "cvss v4.0 (anchors) + platform severity + whatweb native fallback: OK" (termasuk server lokal + `pentest_scan tool=whatweb` yang membuktikan fallback); live lewat route: Mia memanggil `cvss_score` → **9.3 critical** untuk vektor v4, dan memuat `web-cache-poisoning` dengan 3 langkah pertama yang benar. Gates: typecheck, lint (0 temuan baru), vitest **51/51**, `verify.ts` EXIT=0. Docs (README/MIA_FEATURES) diperbarui ke 83 playbook.

Akar masalahnya: `currentTimeLine()` hanya menyuntik **jam sekarang** ke system prompt, tanpa data kapan user terakhir mengirim pesan; model memakai jam sekarang itu sebagai "jam chat terakhir" lalu mengarang jeda/kesenyapan. Ini kelas yang sama dengan REMINDER/SPOTIFY HONESTY: model mengklaim fakta yang tidak dimilikinya.

Perbaikan (satu pemilik, tidak bisa drift): klausa ditambahkan di `currentTimeLine()` (dipakai **kedua** prompt, `buildSystemPrompt` + `buildOpenCodeSystemPrompt`) — "This is the CURRENT time only — you keep NO record of when the user last messaged you, so never claim they had been gone or silent, never state how long it has been, and never present this clock as their last-chat time." Contoh buruk **tidak** dikutip di prompt (pelajaran lama: small model meniru contoh yang dikutip). Guard: `verify.ts` blok "presence honesty (clock is not a last-seen fact) in both prompts: OK" memastikan klausa ada di dua prompt. Live (provider default, channel discord): "kamu kemana aja" → "Aku selalu di sini kok beb… gimana harimu?"; pertanyaan umpan "dari tadi kamu ngilang ya?" → balik bertanya, **tanpa** karangan jeda; "kamu kangen nggak" → tetap hangat tanpa timeline. Gates: typecheck, verify EXIT=0, vitest 46/46.

Catatan (tidak diubah): entri `dailyMemory` menyimpan header timestamp ISO **UTC** (`## 2026-09-17T06:21:…Z`) yang muncul mentah di `memory_get` — sumber potensi kebingungan jam WIB-vs-UTC bila ter-recall; kalau mau, header bisa ditulis WIB (perlu keputusan karena file lama sudah ISO-Z). Fitur opsional: kalau Mia memang harus tahu "sudah berapa lama user tidak chat", perlu simpan waktu pesan terakhir per chat (state adapter) — bukan sekadar prompt.

Residual yang **tidak** diubah (disengaja): body sukses non-stream (gateway yang mengabaikan `stream:true`) masih belum diekstrak jadi teks — semua provider yang dipakai (OpenRouter/Groq/opencodeGo/9router) menuruti `stream:true`, jadi ini pre-existing dan di luar audit; `free-models-per-min` OpenRouter itu kuota akun (failover ke model free lain bisa kena 429 yang sama) — dicatat, tapi failover tetap dipertahankan karena laporan lapangan menunjukkan sebagian model free limit-nya per-model.

## Session 2026-09-19 — Exploit Chain Builder + report target fix

**Exploit Chain Builder DONE (typecheck/lint/test/verify green, live-verified di Discord):** `exploitChains.ts` — automated orchestration of existing pentest tools into common attack chains. 4 chain types:
- **idor**: content_discover → http_request (baseline) → bola_diff (A/B sessions) → JSON field diff → finding BOLA/IDOR (CVSS 7.5)
- **auth_bypass**: Decode JWT → alg:none variants → claim tampering (role/admin/user_id) → finding auth bypass (CVSS 9.8)
- **ssrf**: param_discover → oast_create → inject SSRF payloads → oast_poll → finding SSRF/metadata/RCE (CVSS 7.5–10.0)
- **session_fixation**: GET login (pre-session) → POST login (post-session) → compare session IDs → finding session fixation (CVSS 7.4)

Tool: `exploit_chain` (risk `write`, FR-14 confirm, CORE 128, scope-gated `targetAllowed`). Params: `chain` (required), `url` (required), `session_a`/`session_b` (IDOR), `token`/`session` (auth_bypass), `callback`/`params` (ssrf), `login_url`/`username`/`password`/`user_field`/`pass_field`/`protected_url` (session_fixation). Output: structured finding (title/CVSS/OWASP/CWE/steps/evidence/remediation) ready for `finding_add`.

Prompt guidance added: `EXPLOIT CHAIN` section in SYSTEM_PROMPT tells model when to use `exploit_chain` vs manual tool calls. Findings still need `poc_verify` for determinism before `finding_add` (FINDING RULES).

Live test (Discord, lab Netlify `cozy-kangaroo-42f2e0.netlify.app`):

- `exploit_chain chain=idor url=... session_a=account_a session_b=account_b` → confirmation → execute → **BOLA/IDOR terdeteksi: response identik 200 untuk 2 akun berbeda, CVSS 7.5**
- `exploit_chain chain=idor url=...` tanpa session → helpful message "butuh 2 sesi akun berbeda"

Store `.data/users/<user>/retest.json` (cap 120, lastRunAt+lastVerdict per case). **AUTO-CREATE:** `finding_add` menerima arg opsional `retest_url`+`retest_expect`+`retest_status`+`retest_method`+`retest_session` → case otomatis saat temuan dicatat (output + "♻️ Retest case otomatis: R-…"). **3. `authMatrix.ts` — Role/Permission Matrix (upgrade bola_diff A/B → N-role).** `auth_matrix endpoints=<list> sessions=<admin,user,guest>` (urutan = privilege menurun) × (+ anonymous otomatis) → 1 request per (endpoint × identitas), max 6×6. Pure `parseMatrixSpec`/`matrixGranted`/`matrixSame`/`matrixFindings` unit-tested (termasuk "uniform" = aman/info).

**4. `domTaint.ts` — DOM XSS taint analysis (statik).** Trace SOURCE (`location.hash/search/href/pathname`, `document.referrer`, `postMessage` event.data, `window.name`) → SINK (`innerHTML/outerHTML`, `document.write(ln)`, `eval`, `new Function`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, jQuery `.html()`, `setAttribute("on…")`) dalam SATU file; sanitizer menghapus flag (`encodeURIComponent/DOMPurify/textContent/escapeHtml…`, window ≤15 baris di atas sink). Input `url` (scope-gated; HTML → ambil ≤8 script same-origin) atau `text` (isi bundle dari js_mine — tanpa jaringan). Output: per-flow `file:line sink ← source via var` + snippet; selalu "statik — WAJIB verifikasi manual sebelum finding_add". Pure `analyzeTaint` unit-tested (positif: hash→innerHTML, postMessage→eval; negatif: textContent, tanpa sink).

## Session 2026-09-21 — js_deobfuscate (prioritas #3, recon sadar-obfuscasi)

`js_mine` grep RAW source, jadi buta terhadap bundle modern: string-array webpack/obfuscator.io (`var _0x4c=['/api/x'];…_0x4c[1]`), string concat terpisah baris (`fetch('\n  "https://api"\n  + "/v2"')`), dan source map `.map` yang lupa dihapus (seluruh source asli + endpoint + komentar). `jsDeobfuscate.ts` mengisi celah itu — **eval-free**, bounded (bundle ≤900KB, ≤8 pass, array ≤2000 elemen, map sources ≤120):
- **Pass A** collect string-array (≥2 elemen, SEMUA elemen harus string literal polos — array campuran di kode normal tidak pernah direwrite) dari `var x=[…]` DAN comma-decl (`var base='x',rt=[…];`).
- **Pass B** accessor function obfuscator.io: `function _0x4(e){…return d[e-0x1];}` (offset hex/dec, self-reassign `e=e-0x1`, alias chain via seen-set).
- **Pass C** `arr[0]`/`arr["0"]`/`arr.at(0)` → literal.
- **foldConcats** 8 pass: fold 2-term + 3-term (`"a"+id+"c"` memakai sentinel `§WS§` agar identifier tidak ikut terlipat; angka `1+2` TIDAK dilipat).
- **Source map restore**: `//# sourceMappingURL=` inline atau adjacent `.js.map` → `sourcesContent` ditambang ber-atribusi file (`/api/debug/env  ← api.ts`).
- Tool `js_deobfuscate` (**read/auto**, scope-gated `targetAllowed`) — CORE posisi samping `js_mine`; prompt JS RECON: kalau `js_mine`/`content_discover` sedikit endpoint dari bundle besar/minified → panggil `js_deobfuscate`.
- Slot CORE: +`js_deobfuscate` −`http_history` (log viewer read-only, tetap terdaftar; assertion verify diupdate).

**Bukti:** unit **28 tes** (string-array, accessor+offset hex, comma-decl, fold multi-term, isPathLike, sourcemap URL, safety non-obfuscated) — total vitest **231/231**; verify blok live: server lokal bundle obfuscated+map → endpoint string-array + concat-folded + restored source BERSEMUA pulih, scope guard; CORE=128, groq window lengkap; total tools **298**.

**Pelajaran kecil (anti-regresi CORE):** menghapus 1 nama dari baris multi-nama dengan oldString yang memuat koma menjadikan baris tetangga ikut terhapus (`cors_audit, csp_audit` sempat hilang — ketangkap oleh verify assertion, bukan typecheck). Verifikasi pasca-edit CORE WAJIB lewat probe runtime + verify, tidak cukup typecheck.

**Audit sinkron pasca-build (2026-09-21) menemukan 1 bug nyata:** `workflow_fuzz` TIDAK ada di `HEADLESS_SIDE_EFFECT_TOOLS` — di turn headless (automation/webhook), model bisa menembak mutasi bisnis nyata (skip payment, amount negatif) tanpa guard. Fixed (+tes probe dispatch scope ✅). Sisanya bersih: 298 tools tanpa dupes, semua tool Tier-1/3 reg+core+groq=1, prompt memuat semuanya, CORE⊆groq window, dispatch scope-refuse jalan.

**Catatan provider saat audit (bukan bug):** opencodego kena **429 GoUsageLimitError** (monthly limit, reset 15 hari — bukan kode) dan Groq free **413 ITPM** (persona+128 tools = 38k > 7k, plan limit). Jalur Discord (9router) untuk recon obfuscated: model terlihat memilih `js_mine`/`http_request` daripada `js_deobfuscate` pada drill (tool tersedia di window-nya; pemilihan model, dispatch+guards terbukti di verify).
